say:1:1910705001:1.text: The chaotic carved mural goes on. The swirling patterns are growing more familiar. You start to make out the meaning they convey...
say:1:1910705001:1.source_cn: 杂乱缭绕的刻痕再次归于简单，于是你轻易辨认出了上面的含义。
say:1:1910705001:1.male: The chaotic carved mural goes on. The swirling patterns are growing more familiar. You start to make out the meaning they convey...
say:1:1910705001:1.female: The chaotic carved mural goes on. The swirling patterns are growing more familiar. You start to make out the meaning they convey...

say:2:1910705002:1.text: After countless failures, a desperate being attempts to end its own existence.
say:2:1910705002:1.source_cn: 在数不胜数的失败后，一个绝望的存在试图终结自己。
say:2:1910705002:1.male: After countless failures, a desperate being attempts to end its own existence.
say:2:1910705002:1.female: After countless failures, a desperate being attempts to end its own existence.

say:3:1910705003:1.text: He stabs his own chest, hurls himself from a ledge into the deep, and even gives up his life willingly as a sacrifice. But each time he wakes again wretchedly. Or rather, he kept on existing.
say:3:1910705003:1.source_cn: 他用贝刃刺向自己的胸口，或从高处坠入海渊，甚至主动投身...
say:3:1910705003:1.male: He stabs his own chest, hurls himself from a ledge into the deep, and even gives up his life willingly as a sacrifice. But each time he wakes again wretchedly. Or rather, he kept on existing.
say:3:1910705003:1.female: He stabs his own chest, hurls himself from a ledge into the deep, and even gives up his life willingly as a sacrifice. But each time he wakes again wretchedly. Or rather, he kept on existing.

say:4:1910705004:1.text: The stone wall begins to fracture from the left edge, leaving the mural fragmented and incomplete. In the final scene that's still visible to you, there is a small, curled-up shadow.
say:4:1910705004:1.source_cn: 最后画面停住的地方只有大面积空白，中间团着一个小小的、...
say:4:1910705004:1.male: The stone wall begins to fracture from the left edge, leaving the mural fragmented and incomplete. In the final scene that's still visible to you, there is a small, curled-up shadow.
say:4:1910705004:1.female: The stone wall begins to fracture from the left edge, leaving the mural fragmented and incomplete. In the final scene that's still visible to you, there is a small, curled-up shadow.

say:5:1910705005:1.text: 它像绝望的人退行到最初的胎儿时期，也像是即将临盆的胚胎准备发出新生命的啼哭，你辨认不出那是什么。
say:5:1910705005:1.source_cn: 它像绝望的人退行到最初的胎儿时期，也像是即将临盆的胚胎...

say:9:1910705007:1.text: Pah! People live fine even if they're cursed. As far as I'm concerned, growing old is a curse; being alone is a curse. Everyone's got their own curse, and we all carry it fine!
say:9:1910705007:1.source_cn: 呸，人被诅咒也能好好活。要咱说，衰老也是一种诅咒，孤独...
say:9:1910705007:1.male: Pah! People live fine even if they're cursed. As far as I'm concerned, growing old is a curse; being alone is a curse. Everyone's got their own curse, and we all carry it fine!
say:9:1910705007:1.female: Pah! People live fine even if they're cursed. As far as I'm concerned, growing old is a curse; being alone is a curse. Everyone's got their own curse, and we all carry it fine!

say:10:1910705008:1.text: I know it might not sound right, but it's a shame that guy didn't lose his immortality. It would've saved us a whole heap of trouble.
say:10:1910705008:1.source_cn: 咱不能说这是对的……但可惜那混蛋没把自己杀死，要是他成...
say:10:1910705008:1.male: I know it might not sound right, but it's a shame that guy didn't lose his immortality. It would've saved us a whole heap of trouble.
say:10:1910705008:1.female: I know it might not sound right, but it's a shame that guy didn't lose his immortality. It would've saved us a whole heap of trouble.

say:11:1910705009:1.text: All these carvings and not a useful thing in them. What a waste! We should just hurry and...
say:11:1910705009:1.source_cn: 刻了这么多，一点有用的都没，真浪费时间！咱还是赶快——
say:11:1910705009:1.male: All these carvings and not a useful thing in them. What a waste! We should just hurry and...
say:11:1910705009:1.female: All these carvings and not a useful thing in them. What a waste! We should just hurry and...

narration:12:1910705010:1.text: A muffled boom echoes from somewhere nearby.
narration:12:1910705010:1.male: A muffled boom echoes from somewhere nearby.
narration:12:1910705010:1.female: A muffled boom echoes from somewhere nearby.

narration:13:1910705011:1.text: 似乎有一道半透明的影子，在岩壁拐角处一闪而过

choice:8:0:1.text: To him, immortality was a curse.
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 对他来说，永生是一种诅咒
choice:8:0:1.male: To him, immortality was a curse.
choice:8:0:1.female: To him, immortality was a curse.

choice:8:1:2.text: There's no clue here for stopping the awakening.
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 这里没有关于阻止复苏的线索
choice:8:1:2.male: There's no clue here for stopping the awakening.
choice:8:1:2.female: There's no clue here for stopping the awakening.

choice:8:2:3.text: I can't guess what that last picture means.
choice:8:2:3.source_cn: 我猜不出最后那幅画的意思
choice:8:2:3.male: I can't guess what that last picture means.
choice:8:2:3.female: I can't guess what that last picture means.
